J3ZYG22FFY.title: Samsung - 36 in. Wide BESPOKE 29 cu. ft. 4-Door French Door Smart Refrigerator with Beverage Center - Stainless Steel

specifications.Product Name: 36 in. Wide BESPOKE 29 cu. ft. 4-Door French Door Smart Refrigerator with Beverage Center
specifications.Chemical Disclosures: Free of PFAS, PFOA, lead, and cadmium. Libre de PFAS, PFOA, plomo, y cadmio

features: Beverage Center: Quick access to refreshingly cool, filtered water two ways. Choose from an internal dispenser or a built-in pitcher that automatically refills, with the option to infuse with a flavor.

Extra-large Capacity: With 29 cu. ft. of capacity, this spacious french door refrigerator is designed for convenience, offering flexibility and organization to store and access all your favorite foods with ease.
Dual Ice Maker with Ice Bites: Enjoy your favorite beverage with your choice of ice. Select from cubed ice or Ice Bites that chill your drink faster.

FlexZone Drawer: The FlexZone Drawer is customizable with 5 different temperature settings. From french door refrigerator to soft freeze, this middle drawer can store everything from fruit and vegetables to your favorite meat & seafood.
Modern Design: Flat Panel door design with easy-to-open recessed handles blends into your kitchen to give you a modern look.
Large Crisper Drawers: Two large drawers that are perfect for storing fruits and vegetables.
Twin Cooling Plus: Independent fridge and freezer controls keep food fresher longer.
Metal Cooling: The stainless steel paneling helps maintain consistent temperature throughout the refrigerator
Wi-Fi Connectivity: Use the Samsung SmartThings App¹ on your smartphone to control the temperature of your refrigerator and monitor it remotely.
ADA-Compliant Display: ADA-Compliant Display Easy-to-reach controls for everyone.
¹Available on Android and iOS devices. A Wi-Fi connection and a Samsung account are required.

Starting July 1, 2026, Bespoke AI refrigerators will no longer come with interchangeable panels, and additional panels for existing Bespoke AI refrigerators purchased before July 1, 2026 will be available through the manufacturer’s website.
J3ZYG22FFY.description: Extra-large capacity 4-Door French Door Refrigerator; a revolution in convenience and design, the concealed Beverage Center features both a water dispenser and AutoFill Water Pitcher. Plus a Dual Ice Maker with cubed ice and Ice Bites.

J3ZYGX7CP4.title: Samsung - Bespoke 29 cu. ft. 4-Door French Door Refrigerator with Family Hub 32" and AI Vision Inside - Charcoal Glass & Stainless Steel

specifications.Product Name: Bespoke 29 cu. ft. 4-Door French Door Refrigerator with Family Hub 32" and AI Vision Inside

features: AI Family Hub +: Your kitchen is now the best seat in the house. Watch, listen, and cook with AI Family Hub+¹ - the entertainment hub with 32" touchscreen, built into your fridge. Stream music and videos while staying connected with your family and home. Share pictures, control your connected smart devices and get personalized recipes.²

AI Vision Inside: AI Vision Inside recognizes select fresh foods that you put in and and take out of your fridge, so you always know what's inside.³ Access a list of what's in your fridge through the SmartThings app² or AI Family Hub+ screen.

Beverage Center: Enjoy quick access to refreshingly cool, filtered water in two ways. Choose from an internal dispenser or a built-in AutoFill Water Pitcher that automatically refills, with the option to infuse with a flavor.

FlexZone Drawer: The FlexZone Drawer is customizable with 5 different temperature settings. From refrigerator to soft freeze, this middle drawer can store everything from fruits and vegetables to your favorite meat & seafood.
Auto Open Door: Open the refrigerator with ease, even if your hands are full, with Auto Open Door. With just a light touch of the door sensor, the refrigerator door will open.⁴
Dual Auto Ice Maker: Select from cubed ice or Ice Bites to chill your drink faster.⁶
AI Energy Mode with SmartThings: SmartThings Energy lets you monitor and manage your refrigerator's power usage. Reduce your energy use by up to 10%⁷ with AI Energy mode,⁸ all from your phone.
AI Inverter Compressor: The AI Inverter Compressor learns your usage patterns to adjust speed and use less energy.⁸ Plus, it is backed by a 10 year warranty.⁹
Twin Cooling Plus: Independent fridge and freezer controls keep food fresher longer.
ENERGY STAR Certified: ENERGY STAR certified refrigerators are energyefficient¹⁰ without compromising performance.
